title: 诠释的权衡：历史研究中的置信度、权衡与理论流变——从人物还原到范式转移的五个应用 / The Tradeoffs of Interpretation: Confidence, Trade-offs, and Theoretical Change in Historical Research — Five Applications from Restoring Persons to Paradigm Shifts
description:
中文. 本著作提出“诠释即置信度分配”的诊断框架，用以解释历史学为什么在材料增加时仍然争吵不休。

核心主张：诠释就是给一组互相竞争的命题分配置信度；“他确实说过”置信度高，“他因此被排挤”置信度中，“这标志时代转向”置信度低。一个诠释的形状，由这组分布决定。

结构与证据：25 章、附录 A—AC、19 幅图；四层置信度（观察、推理、诠释、因果）配可反驳条件；以贝叶斯更新示范先验敏感性，以编码敏感性模拟说明“合理编码也能翻掉弱结论”。

诚实的纪律：每条判断标层级与强度；把一次失败（C-A-T 在史学中的形式化尝试被撤回）写进正文而非只放附录；开放问题、可证伪登记簿与自诊工作表随书公开。

边界：在历史这类对象上，诊断只能到隐喻一级；置信度分配可操作，三角位置尚不可独立测量。

版本：2026-10-18，201 页，25 章，19 图，附录 A—AC；含工作手册与复算脚本，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/interpretation-tradeoff。首选预览文件：interpretation-tradeoff-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This work presents a diagnostic framework: interpretation is the allocation of confidence to competing propositions. Core thesis: “he did say it” carries high confidence, “he was therefore marginalised” medium, “this marks a turning point of an age” low; the shape of an interpretation is the distribution of those confidences. Structure and evidence: 25 chapters, appendices A–AC, 19 figures; four confidence layers (observation, inference, interpretation, causation), each with refutation conditions; a Bayesian demonstration of prior sensitivity and a coding-sensitivity simulation showing that reasonable coding can invert weak conclusions. Discipline: every judgement carries its layer and strength; one failure — the attempt to formalise C-A-T positions in historiography — is reported in the main text, not buried in an appendix; worksheets and a falsifiability register are included. Boundaries: for objects like history, diagnosis reaches only the level of metaphor; confidence allocation is operational, while triangle positions are not yet independently measurable. Edition: 2026-10-18, 201 pages, 25 chapters, 19 figures, appendices A–AC.
notes: 科目（中文）：史学理论 Historiography、历史哲学 Philosophy of History、诠释学 Hermeneutics、科学哲学 Philosophy of Science、知识论 Epistemology、复杂系统 Complex Systems。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：25 章，约 201 页。首选预览文件：interpretation-tradeoff-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。
